answer: The nebula counter is kept in lotus and pigment reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3360 identities would post 1094 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
